title: Lean formalization of: Universal rotational invariance of two-point functions in cubic lattice models: Ising, Potts and O(N)
description: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization accompanying the paper. It contains the abstract theorem on reflection-positive kernels on Z^3 (rotational invariance of susceptibility-normalized two-point tangents) and its applications to the Ising, Potts/random-cluster, XY, Heisenberg and O(N) models. Build with `lake exe cache get && lake build`; check with `python3 scripts/check_paper_statements.py`.
